To train an RNN you @@T0@@unroll@@T1@@ i.zh: 要训练一个 RNN，你需将其 @@T0@@展开@@T1@@ 为一个权重共享的深层前馈图，然后在其上运行普通的反向传播。逐步走一遍反向传播过程：在每一个状态处，观察其梯度累积两个部分 —— 一部分来自此处的损失，另一部分从未来回传 —— 并观察截断如何切断这条链，以及逐步的乘积如何悄无声息地消失或爆炸。
To train an RNN you @@T0@@unroll@@T1@@ i.src: To train an RNN you unroll it into a deep feed-forward graph with shared weights, then run ordinary backprop across it. Walk the backward pass step by step: at each state, watch its gradient accumulate two pieces — one from the loss right here, one carried back from the future — and see how truncation cuts the chain and how the per-step product quietly vanishes or explodes.

@@T0@@~9 min@@T1@@\n @@T2@@Deep Lea.zh:
@@T0@@约 9 分钟@@T1@@
      @@T2@@深度学习 · RNN · 反向传播@@T3@@

An RNN reuses one cell at every timestep.zh: RNN 在每一个时间步复用同一个单元，因此在时间维度上它看起来就像一个非常深的网络，其各层都共享权重 $w_h, w_x, b$。把它画成展开形式，它就只是一条链：输入 $x_t$ 从下方进入，输出/损失 $\mathcal{L}_t$ 从上方读出，而隐藏状态从左到右贯穿其中。
An RNN reuses one cell at every timestep.src:
An RNN reuses one cell at every timestep, so in time it looks like a very deep
      network whose layers all share the weights $w_h, w_x, b$. Draw it unrolled and
      it is just a chain: inputs $x_t$ come in from below, an output/loss $\mathcal{L}_t$
      is read off above, and the hidden state is threaded left to right.

Backprop on this graph has a name &mdash.zh: 在此图上的反向传播有一个名字 —— @@T0@@随时间反向传播@@T1@@。它唯一的小麻烦在于：每个隐藏状态都会馈入 @@T2@@两@@T3@@ 处，因此其梯度是两份输入贡献的 @@T4@@和@@T5@@。
Backprop on this graph has a name &mdash.src: Backprop on this graph has a name — backpropagation through time. Its one wrinkle: every hidden state feeds two places, so its gradient is a sum of two incoming contributions.

Seven timesteps, unrolled. Press @@T0@@S.zh: 七个时间步，已展开。按 @@T0@@后向步进@@T1@@ 将梯度前沿从最后一步向第一步移动。在每一个状态处，两份贡献会亮起：竖直箭头是局部损失梯度，水平箭头是从 $h_{t+1}$ 回传的贡献。@@T2@@截断长度 $K$@@T3@@ 滑块会切断这条链 —— 变灰的状态被截断，任何贡献都无法到达它们。
Seven timesteps, unrolled. Press @@T0@@S.src: Seven timesteps, unrolled. Press Step backward to move the gradient frontier from the last step toward the first. At each state the two contributions light up: the vertical arrow is the local loss gradient, the horizontal arrow is credit carried back from $h_{t+1}$. The truncation $K$ slider severs the chain — greyed states are cut off, and no credit ever reaches them.

The RNN unrolled over 7 timesteps. Blue.zh: RNN 在 7 个时间步上展开。蓝色 = 前向传播。橙色 = 反向流动的梯度。变淡的状态是被截断长度 $K$ 切断的。
The RNN unrolled over 7 timesteps. Blue.src: The RNN unrolled over 7 timesteps. Blue = forward pass. Orange = gradients flowing backward. Faded states are severed by truncation $K$.

@@T0@@@@T1@@@@T2@@ forward pass@@T3@@\n.src: forward pass local loss gradient credit carried back severed by truncation

@@T0@@Press Step backward.@@T1@@ Watch t.zh: @@T0@@按「后向步进」。@@T1@@ 观察前沿向左推进，以及「到达前沿的贡献」数值的变化。每跳一次都会将其乘以 $|w_h|\cdot\sigma'$ —— 把该乘积设为小于 1，贡献在回传途中会 @@T2@@消失@@T3@@；设为大于 1，则会 @@T4@@爆炸@@T5@@。
@@T0@@Press Step backward.@@T1@@ Watch t.src: Press Step backward. Watch the frontier march left and the "credit reaching frontier" number change. Each hop multiplies it by $|w_h|\cdot\sigma'$ — set that product below 1 and credit vanishes as it travels back; set it above 1 and it explodes.

Why long-range credit is so fragile.zh: 为何长程贡献如此脆弱
Why long-range credit is so fragile.src: Why long-range credit is so fragile

Trace the credit that reaches an early s.zh: 追踪从靠后的损失 $h_T$ 传回到靠前状态 $h_t$ 的贡献。它必须经过其间每一条循环边，而每条边都贡献相同的雅可比因子。因此整条路径是一个 @@T0@@乘积@@T1@@：
Trace the credit that reaches an early s.src: Trace the credit that reaches an early state $h_t$ from a late loss $h_T$. It has to pass through every recurrent edge in between, and each edge contributes the same Jacobian factor. The whole path is therefore a product:

If $|w_h\\,\\sigma'| &lt; 1$, that produ.zh: 若 $|w_h\,\sigma'| < 1$，该乘积按指数衰减 —— 这就是 @@T0@@梯度消失@@T1@@。遥远的时间步几乎得不到任何学习信号。
If $|w_h\\,\\sigma'| &lt; 1$, that produ.src: If $|w_h\,\sigma'| < 1$, that product decays exponentially — the vanishing gradient. Distant timesteps get essentially zero learning signal.

If $|w_h\\,\\sigma'| &gt; 1$, it grows e.zh: 若 $|w_h\,\sigma'| > 1$，它按指数增长 —— 这就是 @@T0@@梯度爆炸@@T1@@，梯度裁剪只能掩盖它，而永远无法真正修复它。
If $|w_h\\,\\sigma'| &gt; 1$, it grows e.src: If $|w_h\,\sigma'| > 1$, it grows exponentially — the exploding gradient, which gradient clipping papers over but never truly fixes.

Only $|w_h\\,\\sigma'| \\approx 1$ prese.zh: 只有 $|w_h\,\sigma'| \approx 1$ 才能在长程上保住贡献 —— 这是一条普通 RNN 无法可靠地稳住的剃刀边缘。
Only $|w_h\\,\\sigma'| \\approx 1$ prese.src: Only $|w_h\,\sigma'| \approx 1$ preserves credit over long ranges — a razor's edge that plain RNNs cannot reliably sit on.

@@T0@@Truncated BPTT is the practical co.zh: @@T0@@截断式 BPTT 是实用的折中。@@T1@@ 你不再展开整个序列，而是只反向传播 $K$ 步并切断其余部分（灰色区域）。它限制了每次更新的计算与内存开销，并驯服了梯度爆炸 —— 代价是梯度信号永远无法到达 $K$ 步之外，因此模型根本无法学习长于其截断窗口的依赖关系。
@@T0@@Truncated BPTT is the practical co.src: Truncated BPTT is the practical compromise. Instead of unrolling the entire sequence, you backprop only $K$ steps and cut the rest (the greyed region). It bounds compute and memory per update and tames exploding gradients — at the cost that no gradient signal ever reaches beyond $K$ steps, so the model simply cannot learn dependencies longer than its truncation window.

@@T0@@The fix that stuck.@@T1@@ LSTMs an.zh: @@T0@@真正奏效的修复方案。@@T1@@ LSTM 与 GRU 用一条近乎线性的、带门控的状态高速公路取代了那个脆弱的 $w_h\,\sigma'$ 乘积，使得逐步因子在构造上就保持接近 1。展开图看起来一样 —— 只是贡献的传播之路更好走。
@@T0@@The fix that stuck.@@T1@@ LSTMs an.src: The fix that stuck. LSTMs and GRUs replace that fragile $w_h\,\sigma'$ product with a nearly-linear, gated highway for the state, so the per-step factor stays close to 1 by construction. Same unrolled picture — just an easier road for credit to travel.

meta.title: 随时间反向传播
meta.tagline: 展开一个 RNN，走一遍反向传播，观察截断如何切断贡献链
meta.summary: 训练 RNN 意味着将其展开为一个深层共享权重的图，并在其上运行普通的反向传播。逐时间步地推进反向传播：在每一个隐藏状态处，其梯度累积两份贡献 —— 此处的局部损失，加上从未来回传的贡献。截断长度 K 滑块会清晰可见地切断这条链，而每跳的 w_h·σ′ 因子则显示贡献在沿时间回传时如何消失或爆炸。
highlights: 观察 RNN 在七个时间步上的展开图，包含输入、逐步损失以及贯穿其中的隐藏状态。
推进反向传播，观察每个状态的梯度如何累积两部分：局部损失加上从 h_{t+1} 回传的贡献。
滑动截断长度 K 以切断这条链 —— 变灰的状态得不到梯度，与截断式 BPTT 完全一致。
把 w_h·σ′ 乘积调到小于或大于 1，观察贡献在回传时消失或爆炸。
把普通 RNN 稳在剃刀边缘的困境，与 LSTM 和 GRU 为何要对状态随时间传播的路径加门控联系起来。
